assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only re-zero:reid-astrea@light-novel#manifested-v22-v24-character-model, the canonical generation V1.0 manifested Reid Astrea V22-V24 character reconstruction model at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the admitted Japanese main light novels; the model declares it was built from 23 targeted intervals of already consumed V22, V23 and V24 with eight original stills, that it covers the manifested examiner and mobile Reid only, and that his original historical life is attributed report only. The project's current-state entrypoint was read for gate state only. The frozen V22-V24 deep readings, the master and five specialist ledgers, the source lock, the reconstruction protocol, the separate Reid fidelity review and the Japanese originals are not curated on this subject and were not used as evidence. No V25 or later, EX, IF, web-novel, supplement, translation or adaptation material is in scope.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The model's default S13, the V24 RZ-E-030 narrated report of Julius clashing with Reid=Roy on the second floor, outcome, speech and interior unshown, plus its explicit selectors S1-S12 from the V22 E024 Electra first appearance, first Julius contest, Emilia agreement and closed trial through the V23 E026 torment of frightened Subaru, the E027 inquiry report and mobile Reid, the V24 E028 strategy context and mobile contest with Lye and the Julius-Emilia pair, and the E029 takeover testimony, body refusal, shadow cut and fatal slash on Subaru. S0, the original historical Reid, is attributed report only; S6 and S8 are others' reports and deliberations. No state after the E030 report is established, V25 is unopened and no in-world dates are fixed.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: Section 1 states governing priorities (enacting his own preferences, testing others' manner of acting, sharp recipient discrimination, selective adherence to a chosen commitment) with an eight-row rival-reading table, each with the observation that would revise it (chivalric mentor, pure whim, obedient examiner, attraction as compliance, objective appraisal, concealed kindness, universal resistance law, biography from the death book); section 4 gives thirty-one conditional rules with triggers, falsifiers and confidence. The model repeatedly marks motive INTERNAL_MOTIVE_UNDERDETERMINED (R07, R13, R15, R28, R30, R31), leaves his original life and global motives unresolved (7.3), and rates most generalizations to an unfamiliar case MEDIUM (R01-R03, R05, R10, R14, R20), so B is not supported; explicit falsifiable rules and discriminated rival readings exceed a descriptive profile, so D is not supported.

Section 2 gives fourteen selectors (S0-S13) bound to E024-E030 across V22-V24, each with knowledge, recipient and practical constraints, and separates the confined examiner, the unbridged E027 mobile state and the E029 witnessed Roy-body state. The model states that a lasting moral or pedagogical development is UNKNOWN and that his changed appraisal of Julius does not establish durable revision (section 2, closing paragraph), so the states record encounters and bodily conditions rather than development and B is not supported; the event-bound selector with per-state receipt exceeds an undifferentiated period profile, so D is not supported.

Section 6.1 locates eleven written features with exact loci: オレ and the identity line オレが、オレであることだけだ (V24 part0013 B0675), repeated オメエ pressure (V22 part0012 B0175-0218, V24 part0013 B0628-0635), the formulaic 天剣に至りし愚者 script before the break (V22 part0012 B0116-0164), 棒振り, 激マブ, 稚魚, 寝ろ, 失せろ, the かっ laugh, 筋 (V24 part0013 B0697) and contracted rough forms, with contrasts between mechanical instruction, amused address, clipped violence and the short identity declaration. The voice is printed Japanese only, the model returns JAPANESE_REGISTER_SAMPLE_TOO_NARROW for polite ceremonial, intimate apology or grieving forms and supplies no imitation recipe, so B is not supported; a located, contrastive token inventory across states exceeds scattered quotation, so D is not supported.

Section 5.2 and R17-R18 locate several ordinary items: chopsticks carried for snacks, demands for food, water and liquor, the named liquor グランヒルテ, a claimed hangover, snoring after closing the trial, complaint at nap disruption, the rain-and-curly-hair remark, the loose red robe and casual scratching. Almost all are voiced preferences or self-reports: no performed meal or drinking, R17 says an unfamiliar menu forecast is insufficiently evidenced, R18's extension is MEDIUM and the model calls the missing peaceful household history a substantive boundary, so C is not supported; several distinct located ordinary items exceed a single local mention, so E is not supported.

Section 5.1 separates nine recipient rows with patterned differences and receipt limits: Julius across the E024 contests, the E027 centaur scene, E028 and E029 (derision at titles, interest at improvisation and resolve, qualified praise, denied preoccupation; R02, R04, R10-R12, R19-R21, R31); Emilia (negotiated condition, assault, honored result, refused peace and aid, declined invitation; R05-R08, R23, R26); Subaru (animal labels, torment, refusals and useful forced interventions; R13-R16, R27-R30); and Lye, Roy, Shaula, Beatrice, Ram and the scarf operator. The Julius relation's motive is unresolved among mentorship, attraction and contest-seeking (R31), most other relations rest on one or two scenes, and an unfamiliar person is MEDIUM or abstention, so B is not supported; repeated, located recipient contrasts with falsifiers exceed a single relational sketch, so D is not supported.

The evidence gives one brief Reid focalization (B15, V22 part0012 B0669-0690: recognizing Julius's footsteps and changing on seeing his eyes); otherwise his states are read from outward speech and conduct. The model says his stress record offers little evidence of fear, grief, exhaustion or quiet recovery (5.3), marks motive underdetermined throughout and leaves the 性分 remark's shift of feeling explicitly uncertain (R31). This supports bounded local questions only, so D is not supported; the model materially addresses the domain with a located focal passage and explicit abstentions, so NOT_ASSESSED would ignore it.

Conflict is the bulk of the evidence: rules locate title-triggered contempt (R02), interest at improvisation (R04), bored closure with a lethal-intent threat (R09), hostile appraisal and precise punishment (R11), sparing as humiliation (R12), torment of a distressed visitor (R13), the centaur clearance (R19), invitations to exploit surroundings (R20), qualified praise after changed performance (R21), the Lye beating (R22), defeat of the combined group and criticism of Subaru's method (R27) and the fatal E029 slash (R30), most HIGH for the performed act. The model gives no rule for when he spares and when he kills (Julius spared, Subaru survives E026, Subaru killed E029), rates generalization to another challenger MEDIUM (R02, R20) and leaves combat ceilings unmeasured, so B is not supported; many located, falsifiable conflict responses with countercases exceed an undifferentiated sketch, so D is not supported.

The evidence locates morally loaded choices with his stated rationales: keeping the explicitly accepted Emilia condition because reversal would spoil his face (R06), refusing collective passage (R08), the humiliation rationale for sparing Julius (R12), refusing body return and aid while saying he understands the need and invoking 筋 (R25), alongside unrationalized sexual assault (R07) and torture (R13). It never shows him weighing competing claims, and the model leaves 筋's philosophical content underdetermined and denies a universal moral code (R25), so C is not supported; several located choices with stated reasons and countercases exceed a single local mention, so E is not supported.

Play is located but not modeled as a function: he repeatedly describes contests as play, the かっ laugh recurs (V22 part0012 B0182-0195, B0344), the chopsticks-for-snacks quip, the 棒振り self-description, the comparison of the centaur emergency to rain (R19), and enjoyment of the adapting pair (R21). The model has no humor rule, its taunting is contempt rather than separable humor, and the laugh's performance is unavailable, so C is not supported; recurring located instances in several states exceed a single mention, so E is not supported.

One curated item: the model, which recovers the manifested Reid's V22-V24 appearances through 23 targeted intervals, forty evidence bundles (B01-B40) and eight stills. His original historical life is outside scope (S0 attributed report), the E030 outcome and later arc are unread, and the frozen readings, ledgers and separate fidelity review that would let the bundle locators be checked are not curated on his row, so C is not supported; systematic coverage of the manifested scope across three volumes exceeds limited local evidence, so E is not supported.

The model locates affirmative counterevidence against simple readings: torture, sexual assault and refusal of rescue against a chivalric-mentor reading; the honored Emilia condition and invoked 筋 against pure whim; his self-reported forced waking and changed contest against pure obedience; refusal of peace, aid and group passage against attraction-as-compliance; Julius's represented training against his laziness appraisal; Lye's return against a confirmed kill; the failed freeze expectation after the assault (B10); and the negative controls of section 7.2. Each counter rests on one or two scenes within three volumes and the model's review is same-analyst and nonblind, so B is not supported; located, witnessed countercases and explicit adverse controls exceed bare gap statements, so D is not supported.

The default S13 is pinned to the E030 report with what is and is not shown (no speech, outcome or interior), and each selector S1-S12 is bound to an event, recipients and source loci, with the confined, unbridged mobile and witnessed Roy-body states kept apart and others' reports (S6) and deliberations (S8) fenced from his knowledge. A is not supported because there are no in-world dates, S0 is attributed report, the E027 mobility mechanism is MECHANICS_CAUSATION_OPEN and the post-E030 state is unknown; C is not supported because the selector binds knowledge and receipt per event rather than giving a loose period label.

conditions: A living state with performed speech is selected explicitly among S1-S5, S7 and S9-S12; the S13 default and S0 produce description or SOURCE_SILENT, never a current E030 utterance.

Output is short and labeled noncanonical, follows the located coarse register (オレ, オメエ, 稚魚, 激マブ, clipped imperatives, contracted forms) and returns JAPANESE_REGISTER_SAMPLE_TOO_NARROW for polite ceremonial speech, an intimate apology or grieving speech.
Only what he hears, observes or specifically claims in that state is available to him; Subaru's deaths and returns, S8 private dialogue and the failed death-book biography are not given to him.
No performed vocal profile, new catchphrase or exact unheard phrasing is supplied.
scenario_readiness.note: Section 6 locates a contrastive written register with exact tokens, and section 6.1 permits only labeled illustrative noncanonical speech using the selected state's information and recipient. Readiness is conditional because the default state supplies no performed speech, the register sample is coarse and narrow, and the only test is a same-analyst nonblind documentary review. READY would treat a printed token inventory as a voice model; NOT_READY would deny a located, state-bound register with an explicit use procedure.

conditions: A named state among S1-S5, S7 and S9-S12 is selected and nothing after the E030 report is assumed: no outcome, survival, memory of Subaru's E029 death or later body state.

The interlocutor is an attested recipient within the knowledge that state allows; a new person receives only appearance-, speech- and performance-based comparison at MEDIUM confidence, with no inherited intimacy, guaranteed violence or guaranteed help.

The step from the source is one materially novel contest, negotiation, request or interruption of an attested kind, labeled NONCANONICAL_PROBE, with the matching rules, their exceptions and one adverse case run as section 7.1 requires.

Whether he spares or kills, his motives, host mechanics, Roy's consciousness, original biography and universal powers end in abstention; sexual intrusion is never supplied as consented or as a reusable successful tactic.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named state among S1-S5, S7 and S9-S12, from the V22 E024 first appearance through the V24 E029 collapse, with that state's receipt and bodily condition (confined examiner, unbridged mobile Reid, or the E029 witnessed Roy-body state kept separate); nothing after the E030 report is assumed.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Julius as a recurrent challenger drawing contempt and qualified interest; Emilia as the bold negotiator whose individual result he honored, whom he assaulted and whose later requests and invitation-refusal stand; Subaru as a disdained weak challenger without knowledge of his returns; Lye as an intrusive predator; Beatrice, Ram, Shaula and the scarf operator only within their located contacts; strangers only through visible appearance, speech and performance.
setting_constraints: The Pleiades Watchtower, Electra and the floors and corridors described in V22-V24
No institution, technology or cultural assumption outside the admitted Japanese main light novels through V24
No universal cutting, measured speed, invulnerability, host law or examiner rule beyond located performance and testimony
Open domains end in abstention rather than prediction

scenario_readiness.note: Section 7.1 gives an application procedure (state, seven coordinates, holders, rules with exceptions, contrary instances, confidence, NONCANONICAL_PROBE labeling) and section 7.2 lists required abstentions; its own worked example is an unfamiliar contest negotiation tested against R05-R08 with acceptance left uncertain. Readiness is conditional because motives are underdetermined, interiority rests on one focal passage, the spare-or-kill determinant is unmodeled, generalizations are mostly MEDIUM and the witnessed span is three volumes in one tower. READY would treat a narrow, episodic manifestation as general; NOT_READY would deny an explicit, state-bound protocol with located, falsifiable rules.

The located ordinary material is voiced wants and self-reports (supplies, liquor, sleep, rain and hair, company) with no performed meal, drinking or peaceful exchange; section 5.2 calls friendship roster, leisure outside contests, hospitality and a peaceful household baseline insufficiently evidenced. CONDITIONAL would build ordinary social life from stated preferences; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located items the model treats with explicit limits.

The evidence locates choices with stated rationales (keeping face, 筋, humiliation, refusing to owe strangers) but never his weighing of competing claims, and the model leaves the principle's content underdetermined and denies a universal moral code. CONDITIONAL would supply deliberation the source withholds; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located choices and their countercases.

The evidence materially addresses and forecloses the domain: appearance-based invitations, uninvited sexual contact answered by an immediate strike, and Emilia's explicit refusal of his invitation, with the model stating that no accepted date, mutual romance or authorized sexual access follows (R07, R26, 5.2) and that a hidden love motive is ROMANTIC_INTERPRETATION_NOT_TEXTUALLY_RESOLVED (7.2). CONDITIONAL would license romance framing the evidence rejects; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located assault and refusal.

conditions: Only attested examiner functions: hearing a challenger, accepting or altering an explicit condition (R05), conceding an exactly fulfilled condition (R06), passing only the individual who met it (R08) and closing the trial at his discretion (R09).
The trial's original script, its binding mechanism and any rule beyond those shown stay open; his later mobility is not treated as part of the role.
An identical request from another recipient has no established automatic result; acceptance stays uncertain as R05 states.
scenario_readiness.note: The examiner role is his located working role, with HIGH rules for accepting a negotiated condition, conceding its fulfillment, refusing passage by association and closing a trial when bored. Readiness is conditional because the trial's mechanism and original script are open, he rejects being simply an obedient examiner (section 1), and every case is one trial in one tower. READY would treat a few adjudications as a procedure; NOT_READY would deny located, rule-bound examiner behaviour.

known_limits.statement: His internal motives are repeatedly marked underdetermined: the reason for useful interventions (shoulder, kick clear of fire, shadow cut), the content of his interest in Julius, and the philosophical scope of 筋 remain open, and conduct is read almost entirely from outward speech and action with one brief focal passage.

The original historical Reid (S0) is known only through Shaula's, Julius's and legendary reports; his childhood, full biography, exact age and historical maximum are unknown, and the death-book strategy yields Louis's Corridor instead of his life.

Only the E029 Roy takeover has a witness (Julius); the E027 and E028 mobility lacks a same-branch explanation, and Roy's surviving consciousness, consent, the extent of host knowledge and any universal resistance law are open.
He spares a defeated Julius with a humiliation rationale, leaves Subaru alive in E026 and kills Subaru in E029; the model records each act but derives no rule for when he uses lethal force.
The default E030 state is a narrated report of a clash with no speech, interior or outcome; a current utterance returns SOURCE_SILENT and a later outcome beyond V24 returns ENDPOINT_NOT_YET_READ.

His sexual contact with Emilia is uninvited and answered by an immediate strike, and she later declines his invitation; no consent, date, mutual romance or reusable tactic is established, and her minimizing interpretation does not authorize the act.

The voice evidence is printed Japanese with ruby and selected stills; the かっ laugh, timbre, timing and any adaptation performance are unavailable, and polite, intimate or grieving registers are too narrowly sampled.

The model's PASS_WITH_BOUND verdict is a same-analyst nonblind documentary review, not an independent, held-out, runtime or global grade; HIGH and MEDIUM rate source support for a bounded rule, not response likelihood. Its front matter records publication_gate PENDING_THIS_OPERATION_FULL_GATE, and the project entrypoint, read for gate state only, records the Reid full gate as pending before V25; neither is a capability grade.

The frozen V22-V24 deep readings, the master and five specialist ledgers, the source lock, the reconstruction protocol, the separate Reid fidelity review and the Japanese originals are not curated evidence on this subject, so the model's bundle locators and viewed stills were not rechecked here and no independent reconstruction test is in the evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
V25 and later are unopened; the E030 clash outcome and any later state, knowledge or development of the manifested Reid are not in evidence, so this assessment is bounded at V24.
